StartPlan.description: What a Client gives a start. Every field may be omitted from a preview; a start needs whatever the plan cannot resolve without it. A value given here always wins over one the control plane would infer.

project.description: Omitted, the Project declaring the repositories, then one named for the first repository.

repositories.description: Resolved as a Project declaration resolves them. Omitted, the named Project's, then the clone's.

integrations.description: The Integration each repository of a Project the start declares selects. Omitted, a Project it reuses keeps its own, and one it declares selects none.

branch.description: The base branch each Workspace's own branch starts from. Omitted, the Project's, then the clone's.

agent.description: Omitted, the only Agent when no harness or model is given, then one named for its harness.

harness.description: Omitted, the Agent's, then the one harness a usable saved sign-in serves, then kestrel's default.

model.description: Omitted, the Agent's, then its harness's default.

profile.description: The Subscription Profile the Session uses. Omitted, the Operator's own Profile holding a subscription for the harness, then the Organization's Provider Credentials.

sign_in_method.description: The catalogued Sign-in Method the Session is handed, withholding the harness's other catalogued sign-ins.

brief.description: The Brief the Workspace starts with, handed to the agent exactly as given.

credentials.description: Provider Credentials the Organization holds from this start on, each replacing any it holds under the same variable. A preview needs only the variable; a start needs each secret.

secret.description: Never returned, and never needed by a preview.

StartClone.description: What a Client found in the local clone it runs in, since the control plane runs no git. Each value is used only where nothing given or declared says otherwise.

repository.description: The clone's origin, as git reports it.

default_branch.description: The branch origin names as its default.

checked_out.description: The branch checked out, used when origin names no default.

outcome.description: `blocked` when `gaps` holds a setup prerequisite or a declaration the start would change. `incomplete` when none does but `missing` holds an input the plan needs. `unavailable` when neither holds anything but an inspection in `unavailable` failed. `ready` when a start of this plan would be attempted.

branch.description: The base branch. Each Workspace works on a branch of its own, which it names when it opens, starting from this one.

model.description: Null when the harness chooses its default.

profile.description: Null when the Session uses the Organization's Provider Credentials.

sign_in_method.description: Null when none is selected, so everything the Organization and the Profile hold for the harness is handed over.

sign_in.description: The saved sign-in the Session would be handed, when exactly one is established. Never its material.

declarations.description: What a start of this plan would do, in order: the declarations it adds or reuses, the credentials it holds, and the Workspace it opens.

missing.description: Every input the plan needs and could not resolve, each naming its plan `field`.

gaps.description: Every setup prerequisite the plan's path lacks, in repair order, then every existing declaration the plan would change.

record.description: The declared record the value was read from, where it was read from one.

StartSource.description: Where a value came from. `project` and `agent` name the declared record in `record`; `clone_origin` is a Project found declaring the clone's origin when `record` names one.

name.description: Null for the Workspace, which is named when it opens.

created.description: Whether the start declared it, rather than finding it declared.

completed_initial_setup.description: Whether this start is the one that completed initial setup.
